title: Desk tray
summary: A 100 × 70 × 16 mm open tray with 2.5 mm walls and a rounded rectangular footprint.
script:
# Complete CadQuery construction.
part_0 = cq.Workplane('XY').box(*[100, 70, 16], centered=(True, True, False)).val()
part_1 = cq.Workplane('XY').newObject([part_0]).edges('|Z').fillet(6).val()
part_2 = cq.Workplane('XY').newObject([part_1]).faces('>Z').shell(-2.5).val()
result = part_2
